description: Cultural Features - Dikes, Dams, Great Wall (Digital Map Database of China) is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors National Bureau of Surveying and Mapping (NBSM), National Geomatics Centre of China. This point and line layer describes man-made cultural features, specifically dikes, dams and the Great Wall of China. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2011. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is terms recorded on the dataset page: For non-commercial use only.. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
